title: Office plant service pilot: watering rounds
titleZh: 辦公室植栽服務試行：澆水巡查
passage:
Crescent Plant Care | Pilot review, Suite 4

We agreed to a four-week trial of adaptive watering for the office planters. We left the east wing on its fixed Tuesday round as a comparison. In the west wing, the caretaker checked the soil each Tuesday and watered only where it felt dry. Both wings recorded the number of visits; only the west sheet also recorded how many pots were watered.

The west wing showed no improvement for its window pots in the first two weeks. Those pots dry out sooner than the ones near the lift. We added a brief Friday check for the window pots only. Some needed water on Friday even if they had been watered on Tuesday. By the end of the trial the leaves in the west window pots looked better, but the Friday checks mean the improvement cannot be attributed to the Tuesday rule alone.

For the next trial, keep the Friday checks for all comparable window pots on both sides. Continue different Tuesday rules between the wings so we can see whether the Tuesday rule makes a difference when Friday treatment is the same. Use a common sheet with one row per pot and a separate column for each visit, including visits when no water is added. Do not judge the rounds by the size of the water bill: the meter also covers the kitchen and the cleaners’ taps.
passageZh:
Crescent 植栽養護｜4 號辦公區試行回顧

我們原先同意試行四週，按盆栽需要調整澆水。東翼保留每週二固定澆水，作為對照。西翼則由維護人員每週二先檢查土壤，只在土壤摸起來乾的地方澆水。兩翼都記錄巡查次數，只有西翼的表格另記澆了幾盆。

前兩週，西翼靠窗的盆栽沒有改善。這些盆栽比電梯附近的盆栽乾得快。我們新增週五快速巡查，只看這些靠窗盆栽。有幾盆即使週二澆過，週五仍需要澆水。試行結束時，西翼靠窗盆栽的葉片看起來改善，但由於加了週五巡查，不能把改善全歸因於週二的規則。

下輪試行，兩翼所有條件相當的靠窗盆栽都要保留週五巡查。兩翼繼續採不同的週二規則，這樣週五處理相同時，就能檢驗週二規則是否造成差異。請用同一種表格，每盆一列，每次巡查各有一欄，即使該次沒澆水也要記錄。不要用水費多寡來評估這些巡查：用水表也計入廚房和清潔人員使用的水龍頭。
